cases.question: 统计我两个教学班各自的人数。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T01' GROUP BY co.offering_id ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 我三个班的平均分对比。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT co.offering_id, AVG(g.score) AS avg_score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T03' GROUP BY co.offering_id ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: O02 班成绩分布：90 以上、80 到 89、60 到 79、60 以下各多少人？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.score >= 90) AS ge90, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.score >= 80 AND g.score < 90) AS e8089, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.score >= 60 AND g.score < 80) AS e6079, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.score < 60) AS lt60 FROM academic.grades g WHERE g.offering_id = 'O02'

cases.question: 列出 O01 班成绩低于 70 分的学生。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT g.student_id, g.score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T01' AND g.offering_id = 'O01' AND g.score < 70 ORDER BY g.student_id

cases.question: O05 班的学生还选了哪些其他教学班？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT e2.offering_id FROM academic.enrollments e1 JOIN academic.enrollments e2 ON e1.student_id = e2.student_id AND e2.offering_id <> e1.offering_id WHERE e1.offering_id = 'O05' ORDER BY e2.offering_id

cases.question: 我的三个班共有多少名学生？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) AS n FROM academic.enrollments e JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON e.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T02'

cases.question: 哪些学生选了我的人工智能班？

cases.question: O03 班的平均分比 O01 班高多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(g.score) FROM academic.grades g WHERE g.offering_id = 'O03') - (SELECT AVG(g.score) FROM academic.grades g WHERE g.offering_id = 'O01') AS diff

cases.question: 数据结构班的平均分和计算机网络班的平均分各是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, AVG(g.score) AS avg_score FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T02' GROUP BY c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_name

cases.question: 我在 2026-fall 教了哪些课？列出课程名和学分。
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.course_name, c.credits FROM academic.course_offerings co JOIN academic.courses c ON c.course_id = co.course_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T01' AND co.term = '2026-fall' ORDER BY co.offering_id

cases.question: 我的三个班一共有多少条成绩记录？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM academic.grades g JOIN academic.course_offerings co ON g.offering_id = co.offering_id WHERE co.teacher_id = 'T03'

cases.question: O04 班成绩最高分是多少？
cases.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(g.score) AS max_score FROM academic.grades g WHERE g.offering_id = 'O04'
